name: Spectacular Brooklyn Penthouse View

reviews.comments: This is an absolutely stunning place to stay. Everything including the bedroom , bathroom and view are fabulous.  it is the best Airbnb I have ever stayed in and better than most hotel rooms . I was visiting my daughter who is studying at Pratt and this apartment was just across the road. The location  is great close to subway and and really easy trip to Manhatton . There are great bars and restaurants really close to the apartment and it was really nice after a busy day to have dinner in one of locat restaurants which were really relaxed and chilled. Rob and Anne were so generous in spirit and so lovely to stay with , you would not get this experience or level of accommodation in an hotel. I am recommending Rob's place to everyone I know and am planning to book myself back in sooner rather than later. Thank you for everything , I really appreciated it.

Robert's space is GORGEOUS!  I traveled with my mother and we enjoyed staying at this Airbnb. Robert was very kind, respectful, and always attentive to our needs and questions. He shared travel tips and restaurant recommendations, as well as MUST DO things in New York. The room was spotless and we had water, snacks, coffee, and tea waiting for us.  Robert's description of the space doesn't do justice to what you are getting... also WHAT A VIEW!!!  I will definitely be back!! Thank you for everything, Robert! 10/10!!!

The host couple were very friendly and made us feel at home in New York. The room has a nice view. The room and bathroom are very comfortable. The landlord helped us a lot and gave us a lot of recommendation. We were lucky enough to live here during our time in New York.❤️

Robert and Ann are very nice couple. They got me a very warm welcome as a family member. They gave me all good advices and answered all my questions.
The room are very nice and awesome location, a lot better than the picture you saw on the Airbnb. The last but not least the bed are so very comfortable.
I was so happy that I have chosen this place for my vacation, It really worth it.

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Bob et sa compagne. La chambre est agréable et confortable. La salle de bain est très agréable avec cette vue magnifique sur la skyline depuis la baignoire ! Nous sommes déçus de pas être restés plus longtemps .. Nous reviendrons 😁 Bref c’est un Airbnb à ne pas rater autant pour les hôtes que pour le logement.

Staying at Bob’s was one of our best airbnb experiences ever. Bob was an amazing host and we definitely had a great time. The bedroom and bathroom were nice and clean. The panoramic view from the bedroom’s window is even better once you see it. Definitely we highly recommend Bob’s place. Thanks a lot again, amigo.

Rob and Anne were warm, generous, and welcoming hosts. Communication was easy and prompt. The bedroom and the bathroom were both clean and well appointed. The views are spectacular. The deep tub is a nice bonus. Rob went above and beyond in making us feel comfortable, from coffee together in the morning to treats in the room, we would definitely stay here again.
Bobs place was awesome and he was super helpful and friendly!  We will return!
Will stay here again!!! Great art, design!!

Robert went above and beyond to make us feel cared for and like a part of his family during our stay which we really appreciated. He provided us with great recommendations, pleasant hospitality, and plenty of accommodations to allow us to really enjoy our time. We felt very welcomed and comfortable during the entire duration of our trip. His place is in a great location to explore Brooklyn, as well as, provides an absolutely stunning view of the city. The bathtub was an incredible way to relax and wind down after long days of walking and exploring. We really enjoyed our time and are so appreciative of Robert and his family for assisting us in cultivating such a great NYC experience.
The apartment & especially bathroom had the most amazing view. Bob was a great communicator and very friendly and super flexible and friendly host. Definitely recommend his place.
Such a convenient & lovely place with an amazing view of the city. I’d love to revisit.

Un plaisir de discuter avec Robert apres une bonne journée de vacances.
Le Bourbon était exceptionnel.
Merci pour votre hospitalité.

Spectacular location and wonderful host. Bob was massively welcoming and generous. The apartment was spotless; the bed was comfortable. The location was mind-blowingly awesome. Our stay was memorable for absolutely all the right reasons. Thank you Bob... you're a gentleman and a scholar.

I was in NYC for a bike riding event and Bob truly went out of his way to make me feel at home throughout the stay. He let me drop my bags off early, have my bike safely stored at his place and even let me stay over the check out time (which I appreciated given my flight was in the evening). The room is clean/spotless and the view of the city is breathtaking. Bob even stocked up the mini-fridge with treats and various drinks (including whisky!) which wasn't expected. Bob is very generous with his resources and time to make sure you feel at home and have the perfect experience in NY...hospitality at its finest!  Location is perfect in that you get a local vibe with shops/restaurants right below the building but still just a couple of miles away from DUMBO. Subway is location within minutes from his place and there's several Citi bike stations nearby. All in all, highly recommend!

Robert was a great host.  We felt welcome and comfortable in his home. He gave us great recommendations for local restaurants.  The bedroom and bathroom were very clean and the "extras" provided (snacks and beverages) were a great touch.

We had a wonderful stay, Bob was welcoming and friendly. He gave us great tips of restaurants and places to visit. He was generous with his time and the hospitality was top notch with fresh coffee every morning. The views from the apartment were fantastic and the location was perfect for us in Brooklyn. This apartment was a great base for exploring. We would love to come back!

Bob was very responsive and made us feel at home.  The bedroom and bathroom were bright and immaculate and well situated for privacy.  Bob stocked refreshments in the mini fridge as well as snacks which were convenient because we were really on the run and those little touches  were so helpful.  We definitely plan to return.
If I am thinking to visit NY again, definitely I will choose to book the same room again.
Robert è stato un host veramente disponibile e molto simpatico, ci ha fornito di un sacco di benefit come bevande, snack ed addirittura i biglietti per il MOMA

Immersed in urban splendor, Robert's penthouse is a city-lover's dream. The panorama from the balcony is mesmerizing, an unbroken view of the cityscape, best savored with a glass in hand. Inside, the space exudes style and comfort, each corner meticulously maintained and pristinely clean.
Generously welcomed by a range of complimentary treats and beverages, every guest is made to feel at home. Robert's hospitality shines through his attention to detail, from the expertly brewed morning coffee to engaging chats that add a personal touch.
This penthouse is more than a place; it's an experience. It's the intersection of a remarkable view, remarkable comfort, and remarkable host. Eagerly anticipating my return, Robert's Airbnb is a journey I can't wait to embark on again.

A highly recommended Penthouse to visit. Had a great time there.
Mr Robert is such a kind and hospitable host, the view was perfect.
So far the greatest AirBNB I’ve ever been in.
Thanks Mr Robert

Robert is so friendly and helpful. We really enjoyed our conversations and the nice touches. Our highlight was getting to know him and his partner and sharing life stories. Amazing location with beautiful views. Highly recommend.  A real gem.
Bob is such a kind and interesting person. He also makes incredible coffee! I had a great time and his place is beautiful.
Robert was an exceptional host and the views from his penthouse apartment were extraordinary!! Wonderful experience!

name: Lovely Little Jr. 1bdrm Apt w/ Rooftop

reviews.comments: Super great place for the price! I like the cat too lol
Was exactly as expected from the listing, great value place to stay for a visit!

Not true to the description, had no ac and no towels first entering into building. Had to ask for it. And get installed while in the small apartment. Hard to communicate with host. Just not something id ever come back to.
Great value space with access to two lines into the city or further into Brooklyn. Amber’s roof deck was so lovely! Much appreciated!

Dreamy apartment in a great location. We were 2 friends sharing - bed was a bit small for that, but would be perfect for a couple. The place is just as described, very clean, location is great & the roof is amazing! Amber's communication was quick & helpful. The only small annoyance was the loud & slightly weak AC unit - which was needed in NY in June... but you can't really avoid that anywhere! Highly recommend.
It was great to stay at Amber’s place. Beautiful natural light and a sense of quiet and privacy in a popular neighborhood.
Had a great stay. The rooftop garden was a nice respite from the hustle & bustle of the city streets.
The view of the greenery from the kitchen window is nice.
the out side of the building may not look amazing but the interior was cozy!! The bed was very comfortable and the location was borderline perfect. The train is just a short walk away!!

Super cute spot in a good location near Morgantown in Bushwick. Nice, clean and well thought out. Cute outdoor area to chill with friendly neighbors and a v short walk to Roberta’s and Syndicated etc. would recommend, great value for money in BK

Amber’s place was a great stay for a short weekend in Brooklyn! It’s in a great area, and walkable to plenty of bars, clubs, and restaurants. The building is definitely older, which is evident. Overall, though, the rooftop access and location were great!
Amber’s place was perfect for my partner and I. Clean, private, and has everything you need!
Amber's place was great! Perfect for a small quick stay in the heart of a great neighborhood.

We had a nice time at the apartment. The terrace was lovely for a morning coffee and we loved that it was bright and sunny! The bed was a bit tiny for two people because the room is slightly sloped/unlevel and we kept rolling into each other. A/C worked well in the bedroom and it was rather quiet.
Awesome place in an awesome location. Make sure to get a bacon egg and cheese down at Eagle Deli & Grill while you're in the neighborhood
Had a wonderful stay at Amber's cosy, comfortable place. All was as advertised. Good location for destinations on the L, and close to other good transportation routes (including a Citibikes station).
It’s basic, but everything is as advertised, good value for money
Really enjoyed my stay with my daughter in Ambers apartment

L’appartamento molto carino e curato.
La terrazza molto utile ed affascinante, Con delle lucine molto romantiche.
Purtroppo non c’era nessun tipo di attrezzatura ( sedie, tavoli ecc) O meglio c’erano Due sedie pieghevoli . ma erano entrambe rotte ed Amber non lo sapeva. Appena gliel’ho fatto presente , si è adoperata per farne arrivare altri due.
È stata molto gentile.
Le strade vicine non offrono molto ( rispetto ad altre zone in città )ma basta camminare poco per trovare tante attività ristoranti negozi eccetera. e comunque due fermate della metropolitana molto vicine e comode anche per arrivare a Manhattan.
Il palazzo è fatiscente e scale sporchissime, tantissime foglie secche nell’attimo e rotoli di pelo ( di gatto immagino ) su ogni gradino delle scale.
So che Amber vive a in California, forse neanche lo sa, O forse semplicemente è difficile mettersi d’accordo con gli altri inquilini del palazzo per fare un minimo di pulizie. Mi spiace doverlo dire ma questa era veramente una cosa molto stonata rispetto all’interno dell’appartamento.
Diciamo che una volta chiusa la porta dietro di se e dimenticato l’ingresso è le scale il soggiorno da Amber è andato molto bene…

The place was nice and homey. There are a couple steep flight of stairs to go up to get to the apartment, we were able to get our luggage up. But might be harder for an older person to get up and down the stairs.
I didn’t feel fully comfortable/safe in the place after a few days. Largely due to the window to the patio couldn’t be locked. It seemed other apartments could also access the patio. This could be a bit stressful for a lone traveller as it could be easy for someone to open it from the outside. I think we used a chopstick at night to “lock” the window.
The area itself felt a bit unsafe because it wasn’t very well lit at night. But it is 7-10min walk from the nearest subway stations. We would walk 10mins to Williamsburg to get dinner and breakfast, which was great.

So cute and comfortable. The apartment was private and quiet and the outside space was perfect to sit at so cute. The place was close to the train and lots of places surrounding as well. Would stay here again
Small but cute! The private patio was so amazing.
Great place and host! Place was nice and clean and had all the amenities mentioned.
Nice place! Cat was cute :)
Cute apartment close to everything! Clean and organized, friendly cat on the roof :) thank you!

It was my first time visiting NYC and Amber’s flat was perfect base for exploring! It was well designed and stocked and having the rooftop was lovely to sit out on. It is also under 10 minutes from 3 subway stations and a bus stop so transport was very easy to navigate. I also tried out the local Syndicated cinema which I really recommend. Amber was also friendly, helpful and responsive. Overall the perfect stay!
Apartamento ótimo para duas pessoas. Experiência excelente.  Se pudesse deixar uma pequena recomendação, seria apenas melhorar a comunicação.

Great location and close to the L train.  Responsive hosts that were very accommodating. Love having the outdoor roof space and we always looked forward to coming home after a busy day seeing all the things around town. Quiet building and efficient use of space. Highly recommend!!!

Great location and cozy space. Had everything my husband and I needed. It is an older building and the floor in the bedroom is slanted but it wasn’t a big deal for us. The bedroom furniture was rearranged when we arrived so we didn’t have the issue of rolling into the person sleeping next to you like another reviewer said. The building was sketchy at first but we felt safe and even walked at night.

We really enjoyed our stay at Amber’s! Check in was easy, Amber was super responsive, and the apartment was cute and very clean. Highly recommend the Syndicated Bar Theatre Kitchen and Swallow Cafe a few blocks away!
The only hiccup for us was the heat – the radiator in the bedroom was on high throughout our stay. Amber was quick to respond to our concern and explained that there wasn't a way to control the heat in the unit as its connected to the entire building. Wouldn't be an issue in the colder months but we struggled with it a bit.
Thanks, Amber!
Amber’s place is great! Quiet neighborhood and a quick walk to the subway or to the corner deli! Perfection!!!
Great spot to stay for a quick visit! While it’s a bit small, it’s got plenty to offer and the location is reason enough alone to book a couple of days!

Please read the full review! We unfortunately had serious issues with the bed and communication during our stay, but if these are remedied this would easily be a four-star review. So please look for updates from other members and the hosts. To their credit, the hosts were understanding and the situation was eventually resolved to our satisfaction.
Let's start with the positives: this location is an excellent way to get anywhere in the city and very close to multiple transit lines. Not the best street or neighborhood but if you are comfortable with big cities, you will be just fine. The apartment itself is extremely clean and cozy with lots of natural light. Great linens, design, and everything you would need for your stay, including great wifi. Check-in was also easy with clear directions. Absolutely no reservations about the apartment as a whole.
Unfortunately, this was the worst bed frame we have encountered in any Airbnb. It was a flimsy metal frame with loose screws and bent legs that looked propped up with strange risers. It wobbled, shook, and squealed at the slightest push. It slid across the floor and was even crooked. We did not feel safe at all sleeping on it, it honestly felt moments away from collapsing. Please look for updates from the host about a fixed bed frame situation because it is essential to your stay.
The other issue is that communication with the host was delayed. A standard question about luggage at 6:30 PM was only answered at 11:00 AM the next day. They mention they are in another time zone, but guests should expect better communication. They also suggested phone texting instead of messaging through the app, even though that is against Airbnb guidelines because communication can only be tracked through the app. To their credit, when they eventually replied, the hosts addressed all questions and were very professional and helpful.
Please understand that this is a great place that just has serious issues which can easily be fixed. If these are addressed, I would not hesitate to stay here in the future.
Good space for short visit. Responsive host
Great place, so cute

I absolutely loved the cozy, minimalist space. It is a very private space. The transition between the grime of the city and the clean, warmth of the apartment is comforting enough to make it feel like home. It was just what we needed. It is also a short 7-10 minute walk to the subway station, which makes it easy to get anywhere in the city.

We had a pleasant stay at Ambers Apartment. It was just a little to warm for us but that’s actually a NYC problem in multiple apartments … opening the window was helpful. The bed was comfy.   I had no problem with the bathroom but my boyfriend is quiet tall which didn’t worked well with the bathroom measurements.
Great host to a great Airbnb with quick and easy access to a lot of great spots in Brooklyn!

El departamento es tal cual la fotos. Perfecto para un par de días en NYC. Muy buena cercanía con el metro y a pocos minutos de Manhattan.
La atención de Amber fue espectacular, hubo muy buena comunicación y supo resolver rápidamente nuestras inquietudes.
La única observación que tengo es que podría mejorar la cerradura de la puerta de entrada al apartamento.
Sin dudas recomiendo el alojamiento aquí!
Amber was attentive and let us know if any changes that were happening in or around the building. Her instructions were clear and the apartment was clean! :)
Loved this place !!!! Super cute

Overall, we had a decent stay and it was a great value for the price. The location was not in the best area, but it was convenient between subway stops which made it easy to explore the city.
The apartment itself was cozy and had almost everything I needed for my stay. The bed was comfortable and the kitchen was well-stocked with utensils and cookware.
The shower and sinks did not drain very well, and the shower curtain clung to my body, which was not the most cleansing experience.
Despite these minor issues, I still enjoyed my stay and appreciated the value that this Airbnb offered. The host was responsive. Overall, I would recommend this Airbnb to anyone who is looking for an affordable place to stay near the city, but would probably not stay here again myself.

Amber was so nice! The place was perfect and in the perfect area for our trip! We ate breakfast on the roof and it was lovely! We messed up our check out time and Amber accommodated us and couldn’t have been nicer about it 10/10 recommend.

Apartment was fine for my purpose—was there for a work trip so didn’t spend much time in the apartment or the neighborhood. Not luxurious by any means, but it was very clean, warm, and the host was kind and responsive.

amber is really sweet and her apartment is adorable ! it's in a very reachable area you r in the city within 10 min you have the subway nearby (6-8min walk) the apartment was super clean and neat , check in was extremely easy. grocery is right next to you and the apartment goes with the pictures you'll see in the Inserat.
really sweet!
the only thing to actually say is you need earplugs like definitely!!! the walls are thin and you'll hear literally everything ! the apartment is old , so you'll also feel people coming down the stairs! when it's raining or windy it is really really loud ! so you will be better off with earplugs ! wished to knew that earlier. but apart from that we had a great stay ! loved the cat. ❤️
thanks for having us
Great location and easy check in. Previous guests left a science experiment in the freezer but no other complaints, I had a great time here!

On est resté plusieurs jours dans le logement d’Amber.
Il correspond exactement à la description sur airbnb.
Il est bien situé ; proche d’un quartier avec des cafés, des friperies, des restos, une super bonne pizzeria ; Roberta s, des métros, etc…
On arrive facilement et rapidement dans Manathan.
La communication avec Amber est simple et efficace.

I want to start out with saying that the host was very attentive and helpful throughout my entire trip. Couldn’t ask for a better host. The unit is very cute and chic. Also the cat was very cute and a nice treat to see.
Unfortunately it’s not in the best neighborhood and it was stressful for me as I was traveling alone. Also the neighbors have access to the rooftop as well (which is fine) but the curtains are sheer and there’s no door to the bedroom area. At one point there was a guy out there and I felt very awkward bc I’m a woman alone. Not saying they shouldn’t have access to it I just wish I had darker curtains or something. also no microwave is a real bummer. Overall if you’re not traveling alone these shouldn’t be problems for you, so I would recommend this unit.
Amber was exceptional with communication. Anytime I had questions she was very quick to respond, and gave me advance notice of a small issue with the bathtub, which was appreciated.

Great place to stay in Williamsburg! So quick to get into Manhattan and Brooklyn!
Perfect!
Very cute aesthetic and a lovely rooftop!

We had such a brilliant time! As previous reviews have said, I would highly recommend if you are used to living/ being in a city, less so if your not. At times it was a little noisy as the walls are very thin, and I wouldn’t want to stray far from the main road that the building is on. However, Subway station was super close and quick, so it was really convenient getting pretty much anywhere.

Amber and Lindsey were amazing hosts! Very responsive when answering any questions I had about the space and things to do in the area. The home was very cozy, my favourite part was the rooftop seeing the neighborhood cat, so adorable!

Overall a great value extremely convenient apartment in Brooklyn within 7 min walk of the L train, direct in to Union Square Manhattan.  Light and airy apartment, comfy bed. Living space quite tight and only seats are the dining chairs, so we needed to sit on the bed for relaxing, but for the price the space and equipment felt fair enough. It’s up a steep flight of stairs so the up/down with heavy cases is strenuous but the reward is a pleasant rooftop space (accessible via a clamber out the window). Cute cat lives on the roof and you are politely invited (not required) to feed it with food that’s been left. It’s simple, and we were happy to do it. We were here for a 2 night stay and would be happy to use it again for a 2-3 night trip for its good location and value.

My partner and I very much enjoyed our stay here. The windows let in so much light and the high ceilings truly feel like something special. Very clean, beautiful rooftop, adorable rooftop kitty, and the projector was super fun for a rainy night in with takeout. Our hosts were very helpful and communicative the whole way through. We would definitely recommend staying here!
Lovely space, exactly as expected!
Cozy space, no issues.
nice place to stay :)

We were here for four nights and had a great stay. Very close to the train & walking distance from shops and restaurants. Coming from Chicago, we felt fine and safe but if you’re not a city dweller you might not feel as comfortable in the area. Curtains were very sheer and there is nothing blocking the bedroom from the shared space rooftop window. Bathroom sink took a while to drain. Other than that, everything was great and we felt very comfortable hanging out and cooking in the kitchen. Would recommend!
The place was great. Just what we needed for a weekend getaway. The bed was very comfortable and the rooftop was beautiful. Would recommend !

Thanks for letting us stay at your place, it was a great apartment overall. Cons: rats, cockroaches and private garden wasn’t so private at all! But it was a great stay and we looked after the cat really well. The area was a bit quiet/ closed mostly and didn’t look like the feel of what the images were about the local area.

The place looked like the photos and had a good location close to a few subway stations. Easy parking around the area if you have a car.
Feeding the stray cat was a plus for us :)
All in all we enjoyed this place and would recommend for a short stay!

This place was so wonderful and quintessentially Brooklyn. A little quirky, a lot of beautiful, a little angular and with the amount of love you could  expect from a quaint apartment.  Thank you for having us! We loved it.
We had a great few days here! the apartment + roof access were very cute, clean, and accessible.
loved the terrace and community cats. also really enjoyed the projector, had everything we needed.

Amber's description is accurate, nevertheless I think it should be emphasized: This is probably not a place for someone making their first trip to NYC. This place, to be appreciated, you gotta know what old apartment buildings in New York City can look like, and be able to trust that a clean, bright livable space is up those stairs, those narrow uneven [NYC style] stairs.
Best for someone traveling light: I struggled hauling my suitcase up and down.

very cool place, access to rooftop was so great (plus added interactions with the kitten 😍)!
apartment was exactly like on the photos, we stayed for 9 nights and it had everything we needed.
location was great - the closest area has a very good grocery store and specialty coffee place, and at the same time
it is very well connected to other parts of brooklyn and manhattan.
would totally stay here again!
Amber was a great host. Quick to respond. The air bnb itself was just cozy and in a convenient location.
Amber’s place is super quaint. My parents stayed here for a week while visiting me in the city and they loved it. They’ll definitely stay here again. Highly recommend.
Our stay was excellent! The apartment was very clean & the bed was very comfortable. It was perfect as a base for our week exploring NYC. Thanks Amber!

Cozy apartment which is well connected to two subways or within walking distance to Williamsburg.
We loved looking after the two neighbourhood cats!
amber was helpful and the spot was quiet and cozy
Was a wonderful place to stay! We had a few issues with the water, but assuming that just what you get with older buildings! Very clean and host was responsive to any questions we had!
We truly enjoyed our stay at this place! We struggled a bit with the water and the heating but Amber was kind and quick to respond to my messages and the rooftop area was the best feature! :)

let me say I'd definitely live here! and if I did, I'd buy: less scratchy towels, a vinyl window cover for the bathroom and nonstick pans. but that's coming from someone who's used to cities and very old buildings lmao. if you're not used to big cities, you'll probably feel sketched out here, especially because the bottom lock of the door literally does nothing LOL. but it's a charming little place nonetheless. great deal if u want a real big city experience.
I will say ,, literally no check in/out messages or anything. only replied to me once several hours after I already figured out the answer to my question lol. least responsive host I've ever had, and if anything were to go horribly wrong, I feel would've been left for dead for like 5 hours lmfao.
all in all, cute place. also hope the cats have somewhere warm to go to, they were shaking meowing for food outside in the rain ://

It was a nice lovely place. Small but cozy, we did have a lil have bit of an issue with the water for the shower but it did get fixed fast. The host was fast with replying to any of our questions.  Very close to the train, literally about 7 minutes walking. & there’s a really good pizza spot right on top of it too. We also did have a bit of an issue with the outside door, but after we got the hang of it was easy peasy.  Would definitely stay there again.
Good connection to a variety of public transport

Stayed at Amber’s place for a month. Great oasis in the city to come home to after a long day out and about. 5-10 minute walk to L train which is very convenient for exploring other parts of Brooklyn and Manhattan. The immediate surroundings of the apartment aren’t very inviting but if you’re willing to walk a bit there are some cool spots around the neighborhood. The apartment itself has plenty of space for 1-2 guests. Tall ceilings make it feel airy and lots of light. Older apartment building with forced heating radiators— older appliances and bathroom. Not a deal-breaker for me but if you’re used to new/luxury buildings then look elsewhere. Overall good value for NYC. Would add an air purifier to the space if I lived there. Neighborhood has lots of industrial activity and some days noticeable smell in the air.

I just can say that I regret not booking this place for longer because it was great. Location, vibe and basically everything was awesome. Close to the gym and couple of nice food stores. Very close to L subway and also pretty walkable! Loved it!

Amber's apartment is very nice and homey. It's in a cool part of town with easy access to the subway, grocery, coffee, and bars. The upstairs neighbors were sort of loud throughout my stay — it's the city though so naturally it's not the quietest place. All around it was a solid stay though.

Amber’s place was lovely for our month long stay in NYC. It was within easy walking distance to multiple train lines and simple to get to Manhattan and other areas. There is also a laundromat right next door which was super handy. The area itself is within walking distance to lots of cool shops, thrift stores, cafes etc. with lots to do. The apartment gets lots of sunlight and has all the amenities you could need with sufficient space. We really enjoyed our stay and couldn’t recommend this listing more!
Amber was a great host and very responsive to all of my questions. I stayed for a month and it was a perfect place. Also, the cat was so cute!
